options: A small, fixed set of categories built into Receivables, such as Invoice, Credit Memo, and Debit Memo
A customer-defined setup object with unlimited custom values
The same thing as a transaction type
A report that lists overdue transactions
questions.explain: Transaction classes are fixed and built into Receivables; you cannot create new ones. Transaction types are what you configure, each tied to one class.

questions.q: What does the 'creation sign' on a transaction type control?
options: Which language the invoice prints in
Whether transactions of this type increase or decrease the customer's balance
The customer's credit limit
Whether a receipt can be reversed
questions.explain: Creation sign determines whether a transaction type normally adds to or subtracts from what the customer owes — positive for most invoices, negative for most credit memos.

questions.q: What does 'natural application' on a credit memo transaction type describe?
options: The tax rate applied to the credit memo
The customer's payment terms
Whether the credit memo is expected to be matched against a specific invoice, or can remain an unapplied on-account credit
The transaction source used to import it
questions.explain: A natural application of 'Invoice' means the credit memo type expects to be applied to a specific invoice, as opposed to floating as on-account.

questions.q: In the Northwind Fixtures Co. example, what sign and natural application did the 'Standard Credit Memo' type carry?
options: Positive sign, no natural application
Positive sign, natural application of Invoice
Negative sign, no open receivable at all
Negative sign, natural application of Invoice
questions.explain: The Standard Credit Memo type was defined with a negative sign (it reduces the balance) and natural application Invoice (it expects to match a specific invoice).

questions.q: What does a transaction type reference to help AutoAccounting derive GL accounts for transactions of that type?
options: Default accounting references
The customer's bank account
The collector assignment
The dunning plan
questions.explain: Transaction types carry default accounting references that AutoAccounting uses as one source when building revenue, receivable, tax, and freight accounts.
